progress.summary: RELEASE-013 second pass. The blocking item named by the previous checkpoint -- "Orchestrator, patch 1" -- was ALREADY APPLIED to .github/workflows/ci.yml at 18:07:55 EDT, BEFORE this task record was created at 19:59, so the previous next_steps were stale on arrival. I re-verified the patch instead of trusting it, and found its fail-closed SKIP guard did not work. ci.yml grepped "^SKIP no local PostgreSQL" (anchored, no leading whitespace allowed) but db008_run_all.sh captures each harness to its own log and replays it via "tail -3 | sed s/^/  /", so a harness own SKIP line arrives INDENTED BY TWO SPACES after the runner has already printed PASS for it. Measured on this tree: PGBIN=/nonexistent-pg16 yields grep -c "^PASS " == 8 and exit 0, with 6 "SKIP no local PostgreSQL" lines, of which the old anchored pattern matched 0. The step would have gone green having executed 2 of 8 harnesses -- the exact mode the surrounding comment claims to prevent. FIXED in ci.yml, inside this task working set: the guard is now grep -qE "^[[:space:]]*SKIP no local PostgreSQL". Verified by extracting the step own shell body from ci.yml and executing it against captured fixture logs: healthy pg16 log -> exit 0 with 8 genuine PASS; preflight-passing-but-6-harnesses-no-op -> exit 1 with ::error::; missing pg16 -> exit 1. Negative control: a real PostgreSQL 16.15 run gives 8 PASS and 0 SKIP lines, so the guard is not vacuously true. Harness re-run after the edit: exit 0, 8 PASS, 0 no-op SKIPs. NEW DATED RISK FOUND AND RECORDED rather than silently absorbed: the hardcoded PGBIN=/usr/lib/postgresql/16/bin is correct today, verified against actions/runner-images that the Ubuntu 24.04 image (what ubuntu-latest resolves to now) ships PostgreSQL 16.15 with the server package so initdb is present. But ubuntu-latest moves to Ubuntu 26.04 in November 2026 (actions/runner-images#14748) and the 26.04 image ships PostgreSQL 18.6 with no 16 tree, so this step goes red then, by design. The preflight now names that cause and enumerates any candidate bin dirs, because 8 PASS is only evidence if the harnesses ran on the major version they claim. I also caught and fixed a dead diagnostic line of my own making: "ls ... | sed ... || echo" can never fire its fallback, because a pipeline status is its last command status and sed always succeeds; that dead line would have hidden the one fact a reader needs, namely whether any PostgreSQL tree exists at all. RESULT RE-ENCODED AS fail for the same reason as the previous checkpoint: AC-1 is compound and its typecheck half still cannot pass (>=1,308 residual diagnostics, 331 not closable by regeneration), and npm ci and build:vercel remain unrun. The fix closes the one gate closable locally; it does not make AC-1 met, so AC-1 stays not_started and this task stays active.

checkpoints.summary: RELEASE-013 verification pass (read/verify only; no file edited). RESULT ENCODED AS 'fail' BECAUSE THE ENUM HAS NO PARTIAL (HF-RELEASE-011-TASK-SCHEMA-HAS-NO-PARTIAL-RESULT): of the gates executed, most passed and one found a real defect, and 'pass' would overstate it. (1) DB-008 harness wiring is BROKEN IN CI, not in YAML: structurally correct (valid YAML, step 10 of 10 inside 'Migration Gates', no 'needs:' anywhere, 12 jobs all independent) and the script key resolves, but six of the eight harnesses are PostgreSQL-16-server-backed and default PGBIN to the macOS Homebrew path /opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@16/bin. ci.yml sets PGBIN nowhere, and on ubuntu-latest each of those six prints 'SKIP no local PostgreSQL at ...' and exits 0, which the runner converts to 'PASS <name>'. The '==8' invariant cannot distinguish eight executed harnesses from two executed plus six no-ops - the exact Wave-33 mode the script header says it exists to prevent. Exact patch text is recorded in this task's progress.next_steps for the orchestrator. (2) All 10 recorded required contexts resolve byte-identically; the four ci.yml-owned names are unchanged by the appended step, and the six REL-003 planned additions also match byte-for-byte, so no branch-protection change is implied. (3) RELEASE-006: toolchain PASS (after clearing a stale ambient npm_config_user_agent), peer-deps PASS, audit --audit-level=high exit 0 with 0 high/0 critical, all 28 npm scripts referenced by ci.yml exist, env guard fails closed at exit 1, 3 static migration gates PASS including scans of both migrations I gate. npm ci, full typecheck and build:vercel NOT run, with reasons. (4) Typecheck cannot pass: 1,384 measured diagnostics minus at most 76 regeneration-closable leaves >=1,308; I independently confirmed the classification statically. (5) Launch gates: both migration files verified byte-intact, both manifests present, zero destructive statements, but no staging target exists here so every apply/postflight/runtime probe is owner-gated.
